name: Band Shoulder External Rotation at 90 Degrees
steps: Anchor a resistance band at shoulder height in front of you.
Stand facing the anchor, raising your target upper arm to shoulder height abducted at 90 degrees with elbow bent at 90 degrees.
Hold the band handle with your forearm parallel to the floor.
Rotate your forearm and hand upward until your forearm is vertical and perpendicular to the floor.
Pause for one count at peak external rotation, then slowly lower your forearm back parallel to the floor.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbow fixed in space at shoulder height as the pivot point; do not drop your elbow.
Maintain an active core so your lower back does not arch as your hand rotates back.
Use a light resistance band to protect joint mechanics.

sources.attribution: Cornell Health Shoulder Band Strengthening Protocol
